race.comment: WILUNA LASS (2) sets the standard after resuming with a decisive Belmont CL1 win over 1000m, winning by 1.1L after being strong in the market. Out to 1200m is the query now, though the way he finished off fresh suggests it won't be an issue. Nicely placed after Taylor's claim and she can repeat the dose. TIGER TANK (5) is the clear danger if forgiven for his last-start failure as favourite at Kalgoorlie, with his runs prior stacking right up. The inside draw is a big tick and he can put his best foot forward today. AMARLIE MISS (10) was solid first-up in a stronger race at Belmont and that form has already been franked. Will need some luck from the barrier, but with improvement likely, she makes some appeal. WHATYOUTALKINBOUT (7) was only beaten just under a length here first-up. Fiore sticks and with that run out of the way, he can feature in the finish. TRAILER TRUCK (6) can be thereabouts first-up on the back of a nice trial recently.
